Name: Gem Infused Fauns for 1.6
Author: Tortart
Description:
Add 8 different fauns, each representing an ingame gem, that will occasionally shed wool and produce milk. Requires Deluxe Barn upgrade (Please don't question the exact source of the milk. For legal reasons I'm to disclose that they milk themselves and leave it for you to pick up.)

These fauns are:
[color=#8e7cc3]Sleepy Amethyst[/color]
[color=#45818e]Ghostly Aqumarine[/color]
[color=#c9daf8]Shiny Diamond[/color]
[color=#93c47d]Warrior's Emerald[/color]
[color=#b6d7a8]Lucky Jade[/color]
[color=#ea9999]Pr[/color][color=#f9cb9c]is[/color][color=#fff2cc]ma[/color][color=#93c47d]tic[/color] [color=#a4c2f4]Ny[/color][color=#8e7cc3]an[/color]
[color=#dd7e6b]Carolina Reaper Ruby[/color]
[color=#ffe599]Topaz Fox-Faun
[/color]
